paper_title: Adapting Whisper for Regional Dialects Enhancing Public Services for   Vulnerable Populations in the United Kingdom
caption: Difference in average word error rate (WER) from Whisper large-v3 after cumulative automated optimisation steps.
model_annotation: This horizontal grouped bar chart illustrates the difference in average word error rate (WER) from Whisper large-v3 after applying various cumulative automated optimisation steps. The vertical axis displays the categories under the label "Optimisations applied," ordered from top to bottom as Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates. The horizontal axis represents the value, labeled "Difference in Average WER from Whisper large," which uses a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to slightly above 0.003, with numerical tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 0.001. For each category along the vertical axis, two horizontally oriented bars are paired together to represent different models, detailed in a legend titled "Model" located at the bottom of the chart. Within each group, the top bar is colored orange to represent the "NESAC ft model," while the bottom bar is colored green to represent the "SESHA ft model." Every bar is explicitly annotated with its exact numerical value at its rightmost end. For the orange "NESAC ft model" bars, values range from a minimum of 0.00257 in the Dates category to a maximum of 0.00334 in the Normalised category. For the green "SESHA ft model" bars, the shortest bar corresponds to the Dates category at 0.00228, while the tallest bar belongs to the Add Spacing category at 0.00344. The other annotated values include Normalised green (0.00323), Add Spacing orange (0.00319), Remove Spacing orange (0.00311) and green (0.00306), and Americanisms orange (0.00299) and green (0.00302). The categories are not strictly sorted by ascending or descending numerical value, and there is no additional visual emphasis applied to the bars other than their respective colors and data labels.
